Question: Which is the best way to describe the AS curve in the long run?

Options: 
A. Always upward sloping because it follows the Law of Supply.
B. Always downward sloping due to decreased demand over time.
C. Always upward sloping due to the effects of inflation.
D. Fluctuates between upward and downward sloping.
E. Always vertical in the short run.
F. Always downward sloping.
G. Always vertical in the long run.
H. Always horizontal.
I. Fluctuates between vertical and horizontal.
J. Always horizontal due to constant supply.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
